You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…
For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is…
The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

translations.web: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
translations.bsb: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
